page: Amazon Web Services c8ine.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an Intel x86_64 processor clocked at 3.9 GHz, delivering 48 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 24 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory is provisioned at 96.0 GB, resulting in a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The server does not include onboard local storage, depending on network-attached Elastic Block Store volumes for persistent disk storage. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero physical GPUs included in this configuration. For network-heavy communication, the instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 75 Gbps.

By omitting internal local drives and pairing dedicated high-frequency Intel cores with 75 Gbps network bandwidth, the configuration provides targeted resource allocation for compute-bound scenarios without paying for surplus memory density. The instance is structured for distributed batch computing, continuous integration pipelines, video transcoding, network proxying, and CPU-intensive web tier serving.
